```bash
uv run python -c "
import csv
from pathlib import Path

files = [
    Path('database/work/historical_league_results.csv'),
    Path('database/pipeline/bowling_bayern/legacy_out/latest.csv'),
]
for fp in files:
    print('=' * 80)
    print(fp)
    if not fp.exists():
        print('FILE MISSING')
        continue
    size = fp.stat().st_size
    print(f'file_size_bytes={size}')
    with fp.open(newline='', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        cols = reader.fieldnames or []
        print('columns:', cols)
        matches = []
        for row in reader:
            season = (row.get('Season') or row.get('season') or '').strip()
            team = (row.get('Team') or row.get('team') or '').strip()
            if season == '11/12' and '7 Schwaben' in team:
                pos = row.get('Position') or row.get('position') or row.get('Pos') or row.get('pos')
                matches.append((team, pos, {k: row[k] for k in row if k.lower() in ('season','team','position','pos')}))
        print(f'match_count={len(matches)}')
        pos_values = sorted(set(m[1] for m in matches))
        print(f'unique_position_values={pos_values}')
        for i, (team, pos, subset) in enumerate(matches[:50]):
            print(f'  [{i+1}] team={team!r} position={pos!r} subset={subset}')
        if len(matches) > 50:
            print(f'  ... and {len(matches)-50} more')
" 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 4096
```

from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter

for fp in [Path(&#39;database/work/historical_league_results.csv&#39;), Path(&#39;database/pipeline/bowling_bayern/legacy_out/latest.csv&#39;)]:
    print(&#39;=&#39;*80)

    seasons = Counter()
    schwaben_teams = Counter()
    schwaben_1112 = []
    with fp.open(newline=&#39;&#39;, encoding=&#39;utf-8&#39;, errors=&#39;replace&#39;) as f:
        r = csv.DictReader(f, delimiter=&#39;;&#39;)
        for row in r:
            s = (row.get(&#39;Season&#39;) or &#39;&#39;).strip()
            t = (row.get(&#39;Team&#39;) or &#39;&#39;).strip()
            seasons[s] += 1
            if &#39;Schwaben&#39; in t or &#39;schwaben&#39; in t:
                schwaben_teams[t] += 1

                schwaben_1112.append((t, row.get(&#39;Position&#39;)))
    print(&#39;top seasons:&#39;, seasons.most_common(10))
    print(&#39;Schwaben teams:&#39;, schwaben_teams.most_common(20))

```bash
import csv
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter

for fp in [Path('database/work/historical_league_results.csv'), Path('database/pipeline/bowling_bayern/legacy_out/latest.csv')]:
    print('='*80)
    print(fp)
    seasons = Counter()
    schwaben_teams = Counter()
    schwaben_1112 = []
    with fp.open(newline='', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
        r = csv.DictReader(f, delimiter=';')
        for row in r:
            s = (row.get('Season') or '').strip()
            t = (row.get('Team') or '').strip()
            seasons[s] += 1
            if 'Schwaben' in t or 'schwaben' in t:
                schwaben_teams[t] += 1
            if s == '11/12' and ('Schwaben' in t or 'schwaben' in t):
                schwaben_1112.append((t, row.get('Position')))
    print('top seasons:', seasons.most_common(10))
    print('Schwaben teams:', schwaben_teams.most_common(20))
    print('11/12 Schwaben sample positions:', schwaben_1112[:20], 'count=', len(schwaben_1112))
" 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 4096
```
